messages:
Jenny: Heads up: my 30th is next Thursday. Low-key works for me but if anyone wants to do a tiny office thing I'm down :)
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Post birthday plans in #people-ops. Use sign-up: https://tinyurl.com/rwd-bdays. Suggested per-person contribution $5-25.
Marco: I can bring a mini cheesecake box (NY minis) and a Bluetooth speaker for a 2-min playlist. Vote: :cheesecake: cake, :balloon: balloons, :gift: e-gift, :plant: plant.
Tess: Im remote but can send a short silly video to play during the break. Also happy to chip in for a gift card.
Rohan: Quick poll react: :cheesecake: 7, :balloon: 1, :gift: 2, :plant: 3 (snapshot at 11:05am PT).
Nina: If cake wins, small logistic note: please pick nut-free options. Ill order from the bakery and label anything vegan.
Jenny: No nuts please :) Also can we do a 10-min "desk parade" at 2:45pm PT? Micro-toast and a 30s montage of clips for remote folks.
people-ops-bot: people-ops notified  sign-up updated by Nina. Last edit: 1812345733.
Marco: Reserved the small kitchen area 2:30-3pm PT. Ill pick up cake at 2:15pm. Spotify playlist suggestion link: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/jenny-bday-mix
Tess: Sent a 12s clip. Sorry its goofy :grin:
Rohan: Copy for card? "Congrats Jenny  you make meetings 5% happier."
Nina: "Happy 30th! More naps, less on-call."
Jenny: Youre all embarrassing but I appreciate it 970 Thanks so much. See you at the parade :)
people-ops-bot: Final plan: mini cheesecake box (nut-free), 2:45pm 10-min desk parade + remote montage, card + small group gift. Sign-up link: https://tinyurl.com/rwd-bdays (last edit 1812345790).
